about: Verified visual lessons can stream from Cloudflare R2 via Triggle's ad-free HTML5 player. The first Class 12 MP4 is on a public R2 development URL for pilot testing; its existing GitHub WebM remains a temporary codec fallback. Other lessons remain Coming Soon until published.

lessons.question: Q1(ii)
lessons.notes: Gemini English narration; no Tamil subtitles. Public Cloudflare R2 MP4 pilot, with existing GitHub Pages VP9/Opus WebM codec fallback. R2 development URL is temporary and rate-limited; use a custom domain for production.
